description: The predictive maintenance model's inputs and label (FMS-52). One row is one vehicle at one scoring time t: its use, faults, fuel and age, and how long since each wearing part and fluid was last changed. Every feature is computed by the core from its own tables over a window that ends at t, so the nightly scoring (FMS-55) computes exactly what the model was trained on. docs/ml-dataset.md explains each formula.

id_columns.name: vehicle_id
id_columns.description: The vehicle. Synthetic rows use SYN-0001 to SYN-0500; never an input to the model.

id_columns.name: as_of
id_columns.description: The scoring time t (a date, Addis Ababa). Never an input to the model.

features.name: mileage_km
features.formula: Sum of actual_distance_km of the vehicle's completed trips whose actual_end is in [t - 30 days, t).

features.name: engine_hours
features.formula: Sum of actual_duration_seconds / 3600 of the same trips as mileage_km. Driving hours until engine-hour meter readings exist (FMS-126); then the meter's increase over the window.

features.name: days_since_last_service
features.formula: Whole days from the completed_at of the vehicle's last completed preventive or inspection record before t, to t. Capped at 730.
features.when_missing: Days since fleet.vehicles.created_at (never serviced in the system), capped at 730.

features.name: num_fault_reports
features.formula: Number of the vehicle's DVIRs with issues_found = true submitted in [t - 90 days, t), plus its incident reports of type breakdown or tyre that occurred in that window. Capped at 50.

features.name: fuel_variance_pct
features.formula: (actual / expected - 1) * 100, where actual = sum of quantity_ml of fuel logs recorded in [t - 30 days, t) divided by mileage_km, and expected = fleet.vehicles.fuel_efficiency_ml_per_km. Clipped to [-50, 100].
features.when_missing: 0 when the vehicle has no fuel_efficiency_ml_per_km (electric), when mileage_km is under 100 (too little driving to judge) or when no fuel was logged in the window.

features.name: age_years
features.formula: (t - 1 January of model_year) in days / 365.25. Clipped to [0, 40].
features.when_missing: From fleet.vehicles.created_at instead when model_year is null.

features.name: days_since_oil_change
features.formula: Whole days from that change to t. The vehicle's last change of the engine oil: the latest completed_at of its completed maintenance records that used a part whose service_item is engine_oil (maintenance.maintenance_parts, maintenance.inventory_parts), before t. Capped at 3650.
features.when_missing: Never changed in the system: days since 1 January of model_year (as if never changed since the vehicle was built; created_at when model_year is null), capped at 3650. Pessimistic on purpose: an unknown history is checked, not trusted.

features.name: km_since_oil_change
features.formula: Sum of actual_distance_km of the completed trips with actual_end after that change and before t. The vehicle's last change of the engine oil: the latest completed_at of its completed maintenance records that used a part whose service_item is engine_oil (maintenance.maintenance_parts, maintenance.inventory_parts), before t. Capped at 500000.
features.when_missing: Never changed in the system: fleet.vehicles.odometer_km (the whole life of the vehicle), capped at 500000. Pessimistic on purpose: an unknown history is checked, not trusted.

service_items.description: maintenance.service_item (migration 037): what a stocked part renews when a completed repair uses it. The part-history features read it.

target.name: failure_within_30_days
target.definition: 1 when the vehicle has a failure event (FMS-125) with unplanned = true and occurred_at in [t, t + 30 days); else 0. A failure found at planned work is not a positive: the model predicts breakdowns, not service findings. Training and evaluation only; never an input.

component.name: failure_component
component.definition: The component of the first such failure, from the FMS-125 catalogue; none when failure_within_30_days is 0.
